gameplay_changes: None. Default addon/native config. No injected relations, money, materials, buildings, villages, kings, victories or Ethos. Native mock connection is used for passive exploration/chunk presence. Before baseline, normal terrain chunks in each 17x17 exploration window are generated explicitly because an embedded connection lacks a graphical client chunk view. Original ChunkEvent.Load and VillageSpawnQueue alone select/place villages and capitals. Temporary test-only exploration region tickets keep the normal view resident until the original spawn queue processes it; all observer tickets are removed before the measurement baseline. During the 300days, only original native village activation manages village chunks.
clock: Vanilla tick sprint; every game tick and dayTime increment is checked. 300days=7200000 actual ticks after baseline.
